```markdown
# On-call handoff — gateway 503s

## Status
ONGOING. Still firing at the end of the log, 2026-03-14T03:59:27Z.

## Root cause
Deploy dep-4471 applied gateway config generation 119, flipping
gateway.pool.perRequest from false to true. Each request now takes its
own connection from a pool still sized at 20. The pool saturates and
callers queue. Every 503 carries:

  ERROR pool req-07401 ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool
  (size 20, in_use 20, waiting 13)

Queue depth grows from 13 to 271 and never drains.

## Impact window
Start   2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z  (first 503, req-07401)
End     none — open at log end 03:59:27Z
Volume  530 of 636 requests failed, 83%. Steady 5/min.
Routes  /v1/cart, /v1/catalog/search, /v1/checkout, /v1/orders, /v1/session
Note    /health stayed 200 across all 180 checks, so the load balancer
        never ejected the node. Failures were invisible to LB health.

## Action
Roll back dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak, finished 02:14:00Z). Revert
gateway.pool.perRequest to false. If per-request pooling is wanted,
raise the pool size well past 20 first.

## Not related
Workers are clean — 1079 jobs, zero errors. Job time drifts 200ms to
2324ms across the whole 3 hours, starting before the deploy. Cause is
an unindexed scan on orders, already tracked as OPS-2210. Separate.
```

**Handoff is above.** The one judgment call is the `perRequest` link. The log shows the config change and the pool errors, not a stated causal line between them.
